sumber: KSSM Form 1 English DSKP (CEFR-aligned). All passages and questions are written for the app.

nota.t: Questions and negatives in the past use did + base verb: Did she go? She didn't go.

t: a/an for one of many; the for a specific thing.
Countable: many, a few. Uncountable: much, a little.
Pronouns: I/me/my/mine, she/her/her/hers…
-er / -est for short adjectives; more / most for long ones.
Irregular: good-better-best, bad-worse-worst.
Modals + base verb: can, could, must, should, might, will.
Synonyms and antonyms.
Word formation: -ful, -less, -ness, -ment, -tion, un-, dis-.
Idioms and phrasal verbs (look after, give up).
Skim for the main idea; scan for details (names, numbers).
Look for reason words: because, so, as.
Infer feelings and character from actions.
Requests: Could you…? Would you mind…?
Opinions: I think…, In my opinion…
Agree: I agree. That's a good point. Disagree: I see your point, but…
Capital letters, full stops, commas, question marks and speech marks.
Linking words: first, then, because, so, but, however.
Paragraphs: topic sentence + supporting details.
Poetry: rhyme, rhythm, repetition.
Figurative language: simile (as … as / like), metaphor, personification.
Talk about theme, mood and message.

nota.t: 32 questions from every chapter: easy to hard. Suggested time: 1 hour.
